permissions.name: zeteo.sources.read
permissions.description: List and read the sources zeteo knows about

permissions.name: zeteo.sources.write
permissions.description: Register, change, archive and refresh sources, and declare relations; also grants Read sources

permissions.name: zeteo.grants.read
permissions.description: List and read who may query which tables and columns, and users' and groups' concurrency limits

permissions.name: zeteo.grants.write
permissions.description: Create, change and remove grants and concurrency limits; also grants Read grants

permissions.name: zeteo.data.read
permissions.description: Run queries over the tables and columns one is granted

permissions.name: zeteo.data.export
permissions.description: Export query results over the tables and columns one is granted, from sources that allow it

permissions.name: zeteo.runs.read
permissions.description: List the record of queries that were run

permissions.name: zeteo.mcp.use
permissions.description: Use zeteo through an AI connected over MCP

systemRoles.name: zeteo_admin
systemRoles.description: Manages sources, grants and the record of query runs

systemRoles.name: zeteo_user
systemRoles.description: Queries the data they are granted

systemRoles.name: zeteo_mcp_user
systemRoles.description: Queries the data they are granted, also through an AI connected over MCP

eventTypes.description: A source's settings, limits or descriptions were changed
A relation was declared between two tables
A grant to a table was created
A user or group was given its own concurrency limits
A user's or group's concurrency limits were changed
A user's or group's own concurrency limits were removed
A query was run, refused or failed
An export ended, was refused or failed
